svg.aria-label: Recoup revenue recovery agent system architecture

g.text: One payment end to end, four enforced boundaries, and a ledger every screen folds over.
The simulator decides whether a payment was
always going to succeed, whether an outage clears,
and how a customer responds. All of it lives here.
No agent module reads this. No page reads this.
webhook-shaped events only → no ground truth crosses
The agent cannot tell which implementation it is in.
If the agent could see the outcome, every number
in this film would be self-graded.
fails the build on a single forbidden import
Five stages, one recorded path per payment.
deterministic lookup first · LLM only for unmapped free text
96.8% resolved by rules · cause recorded once
attempts, prior contacts, local hour, mandate state, language
built from the event stream, not from the simulator
retry now · retry later · switch method · nudge · escalate · stop
ranked candidates, not one answer · argmax with the sum shown
quiet hours · contact interval · attempt caps · consent · mandate hard-stops
runs after the policy and can only subtract. Never a term in EV.
the only code that touches money or customers
adapter call + ledger row. It decides nothing.
a veto degrades to the next survivor, not to inaction
P(recover | cause, issuer, attempt, hour) × amount × margin
Unmapped causes · copy in 3 languages · case prose. Every call has a fallback.
Copy never sees a number. Explanations may only echo numbers they were given.
Malformed output returns None, never an exception. The run completes.
One SQLite table. Seven event kinds. Append-only.
Triggers reject UPDATE and DELETE. Each arm's stream is hashed
when written, then re-hashed on load in front of the reader.
Same world. Same failures. Same luck.
Server-rendered. No npm, no build step.
FastAPI + Jinja2. Every screen is a fold
over data/run.db. A page load never
computes an evaluation; it reads one
Demo writes it once; the browser
seed in the top bar on every screen
FOUR BOUNDARIES · EACH ENFORCED BY A TEST
and fails on any import of recoup.world.
the reason the result means anything
One protocol; simulated and test-mode adapters.
Constructor raises unless the key starts rzp_test_.
KYC deliberately incomplete: no live keys
Runs after the policy. Named methods, veto only.
Every model path has a fallback.
Five batched calls. Malformed output returns None.
Templates never see an amount. Explanations can
only reuse digits already in the case brief.
